title: trace graph snapshot
description: Serialized snapshot of a nixpkgs derivation graph at a pinned rev. Produced by the graph-builder (Rust crate at graph/). Consumed by Scout's and Cartographer's replay executors to hydrate their in-memory GraphLookup / CartographerGraph protocols. Node shape is the union of what Scout (identifier lookup) and Cartographer (reverse closure, maintainers, critical downstreams) need, so one snapshot serves both. No version-range evaluation here; node.version is a plain string.

nixpkgs_rev.description: Commit hash of the trace nixpkgs fork this snapshot was built from.

generator.description: Name + version of the tool that produced this snapshot. Informational.

enrichment.description: Audit trail for trace-owned metadata merged into node fields (e.g. PURLs). Scout consumes the flattened identifiers on each node; this block exists so the snapshot itself records where each non-native identifier came from. Optional — absent when no enrichment manifests were applied.

sources.description: Enrichment manifests that contributed to this snapshot. `sha256` is the canonical identifier; `path` is an informational display hint only. The path MAY be absolute, repo-relative, or bare — reviewers rely on the hash for integrity and use path strings only as a diff-time label. Replay and Steward checks never consult `path`.

path.description: Informational. Prefer repo-relative when the builder is invoked from the repo root, but no schema rule enforces this.

sha256.description: Canonical identifier of the manifest bytes. The integrity anchor.

reverse_closure.description: Attrs that would rebuild if this node changes, transitively, within the snapshot. Deduplicated and sorted lexicographically so the list is byte-stable across runs with identical inputs. Because the closure is bounded by what's actually in the snapshot, callers must NOT treat an empty list as proof of zero downstream impact — only proof that the sampled subset saw no downstream consumers.

critical_downstreams.description: Subset of reverse_closure flagged as critical by the graph builder (manual list or heuristic).
